metadata.title: CLS — General-purpose programming language
metadata.description: An easy, modular and lightweight programming language. Cross-platform by nature and compiled to native binaries.

hero.subtitle: CLS is a general-purpose programming language. Easy to use, modular and lightweight, with a minimal core and host nodes that extend it.

features.title: Built for everything
features.subtitle: CLS combines the comfort of a modern language with the performance of native binary compilation.

facil.title: Easy to use
facil.description: Clean, predictable syntax, optional types and arrow functions. From zero to productive in a day.

binario.title: Native binary
binario.description: Your code compiles to a fast, self-contained native binary with no external dependencies.

ligero.title: Lightweight
ligero.description: A small runtime and a minimal binary. Ideal for scripts, plugins, CLI tools and embedded systems.

multiplataforma.title: Cross-platform
multiplataforma.description: The same code runs on Windows, Linux and macOS. Native compilation per platform and architecture.

cmx.title: Native CMX
cmx.description: JSX-like markup directly in the language to build interfaces with `CmxValue`.

modules.title: Module system
modules.description: Organize your code with imports and compiled `.clslib` libraries, with multi-module type checking.

pipeline.title: How it works
pipeline.subtitle: From source code to native binary through a clear, testable pipeline.

step1.title: Lexer + Parser
step1.description: Your `.clsx` code is tokenized and parsed into a serializable AST.

step2.title: Type checker
step2.description: TypeScript-style type checking with unions, generics and literals.

step4.title: Native backend
step4.description: Native binary emission for your platform, with JIT and WASM as a portable backend.

stdlib.title: Standard library
stdlib.subtitle: Compact, focused modules that cover day-to-day needs.

cta.title: Ready to write CLS?
cta.subtitle: Install the CLI, create your first project and compile to a native binary.

footer.tagline: A general-purpose, modular and cross-platform programming language.

about.title: About CLS
about.subtitle: A general-purpose language: easy to use, modular and lightweight.
about.philosophy1: General purpose: scripting, plugins, CLI tools, apps and more, all with the same language.
about.philosophy2: The core is minimal; nodes (host executables) extend the functionality.
about.philosophy3: Cross-platform by nature: native binaries for every system, without heavyweight virtual machines.
about.philosophy4: Embeddable from Rust, Python, JS, Go, C# and more.
about.layersSubtitle: A clean separation between the language, the runtime and the host.

layer1.title: cls-core
layer1.description: The language: lexer, parser, type checker, optimizer and backends. Environment-agnostic.

layer2.title: cls-runtime
layer2.description: The runtime: tree-walker interpreter, values, stdlib, GC and sandboxed VFS.

layer3.title: nodes
layer3.description: The hosts: clx (dev CLI) and clxr (lightweight runtime). They provide FS, network, CLI and config.

about.roadmapSubtitle: From the tree-walker interpreter to native compilation.
about.f4: Stdlib: math, json, fs, http, intrinsics
about.extra: LSP + VS Code extension + type maps + async/await + CMX + errors with traces
about.repoDescription: Explore the repository, contribute or open an issue.
